Summarise raw IV-GMM simulation results

Source: R/sim-iv-summary.R
summarise_iv_results.Rd

Aggregates the raw per-replicate output from sim_iv_run() to one row per (method, design, n, kx, q) cell.

Usage

summarise_iv_results(raw)

Arguments

raw

A data frame with columns returned by sim_iv_run().

Value

A data frame with bias, RMSE, mean standard error, coverage, mean CI length, effective sample size, and overidentification diagnostics.

See also

sim_iv_run()

Examples

raw <- sim_iv_run(
  designs = "dgp1_iv_justid_linear",
  n_vals = 100,
  q_vals = c(1, 2),
  n_reps = 2,
  methods = "iv_oracle",
  verbose = FALSE
)
summarise_iv_results(raw)
#>      method                design   n kx q n_reps n_failed       bias      rmse
#> 1 iv_oracle dgp1_iv_justid_linear 100  2 1      2        0 -0.2661551 0.3547985
#>     se_mean cover   ci_len     neff J_median pval_J_median reject_J
#> 1 0.5922282     1 2.321492 15.09131       NA            NA       NA
